title: Chapter 124 Small World
content:
Chapter 124 Small World

Three months later, the entire Lost Land has been pacified by the Yu Kingdom, including the three major forces of the Edel Alliance, the Kuleer Alliance, and the Ryan Kingdom, all of which have been brought under the Yu Kingdom.

The reason why it can be done so quickly is to pacify a place equivalent to a province in China. In addition to Zhong Yu surrendering to avoid death, and retaining certain powers of those in power, and the soldiers under his command were forced by Zhong Yu to attack fiercely regardless of casualties.

The most important thing is that all the forces have received the news that their own gods have been wiped out in one fell swoop and completely fallen.

In fear, he dared not resist too much, afraid that the person on the opposite side would attack again and use the power of the same level as the gods to kill them all.

And Zhong Yu, what is he doing right now! It turned out that when the army set off, he forced the barbarians to build one after another magic circles in various places according to their own ideas.

At this moment, these magic circles have been completely completed, forming a huge magic circle centered on Luoyang. And at every node of the magic circle, all the barbarians around were gathered, forcing them there, and no one could escape.

Calculated in this way, looking from the sky to the plain, every node is densely packed, and there are at least tens of thousands of them.

If you look closely, you will find that these nodes draw a line between each other, which is a huge formation, full of mystery.

Zhong Yu, standing at the main altar of this formation at this moment, under the watchful eyes of the remaining soldiers of the Imperial Kingdom behind him, bursts of purple-golden light erupted all over his body.

This is his unique zhenqi, the special zhenqi cultivated by Emperor Tianyi Kungfu. This true energy has a unique connection with this formation, and only one's own true energy can activate the entire formation.

As Zhong Yu's zhenqi entered the main altar of the formation, a beam of light piercing the sky burst out from the main altar. With the lighting of the beam of light, some smaller beams of light erupted at various nodes on the plain.

In an instant, in the southeast direction of the mainland, in the middle of a forest that no one else could reach, beams of light lit up one after another, connecting the sky and the earth, and everyone on the mainland could see it.

Every time a beam of light was lit, the flesh and blood of the barbarians around the beam immediately dissipated, melting like ice and snow, turning into pus and flowing into the ground.

Not long after, when all the beams of light were lit, the hundreds of thousands of barbarians on the plain were completely wiped out, leaving no one left.

All of a sudden, all the powerhouses in the continent speculated and tried all kinds of methods to find out what was born?

Only those gods, gods and humans, these transcendent existences, are all furious. Obviously, they must understand that this is the intruder they have been looking for for a long time.

But he didn't expect that he would want to do such a thing, directly divide the main world, and dare to do such a heinous disaster? Aren't you afraid of the punishment of heaven?

Sure enough, a giant black eye appeared in the sky again, but it was even bigger and more powerful than the Eye of Heaven that Zhong Yu had summoned before.

But just as this giant eye condensed and released countless thunderbolts, they crazily smashed down the plain where the beam of light was located. But it was firmly blocked by the formation formed by those beams of light, and he remained unmoved at all.

And the system started to move at this time, infinite white light erupted from Zhong Yu's body, directly forming countless filaments, which were firmly inserted into various places on the plain, and picked up the plain from the ground like a net.

These filaments seemed to be extremely weak and would break at the touch of a touch, but they were also extremely tough. With his efforts, the entire plain was slowly picked up from the ground.

The plain shook for a while, turbulent because it was about to break away from the entire continent. And right behind Zhong Yu, those people were even more embarrassed, and fell to the ground after shaking for a while, firmly grasping any fulcrum on the ground, for fear of falling out.

Finally, after more than an hour, the entire plain was pulled up by the system and suspended in midair.

After the giant eye saw this situation, it became even more angry. More and more spiritual energy gathered around it, spinning rapidly, condensing into thunderclouds one after another.

Crackling, thunderbolt strikes one after another, densely packed, there is no gap in the thousands of miles of plains, and all the places covered by the beam of light have been struck down without a trace.

For a moment, the attention was a little shaky, and there were clicks and clicks everywhere. One after another, relatively small cracks appeared everywhere on the formation formed by the beam of light.

It seems that this formation can't last long, but this plain has been systematically cut off from the connection with Tiandao, and dug it out from Tiandao's body.

Then the system can directly inhale the plain into the body.

Sure enough, the plain above the sky disappeared piece by piece. With every passing minute, the plain disappears an area the size of a county.

But in just over 80 minutes, a place with a radius of thousands of miles, a province as large as more than 80 counties, just disappeared from this world without a trace.

And Zhong Yu also disappeared along with Ping Yuan, and came to the inside of the system.

Seeing that his body was so rigid that someone had dug it away, Tiandao was furious, he couldn't find the enemy, and was run away by them.

Then he had to find someone else to vent his anger. The thunder struck the surrounding creatures, one after another powerful monsters, and the native creatures living in the forest. They found an innocent disaster, and they were affected by the fish in the pond, and many died.

At this moment, all the plains inside the system were completely driven into nothingness. It was transformed into the most basic luck, and then according to Zhong Yu's requirements, the system created creations in the void again, condensing pieces of soil, various forest vegetation, mountains and rivers, and some animals, reappearing.

But this is no longer a plain, but a variety of terrain including forests, hills, grasslands, lakes, basins, and plains.

Almost all terrains that are conducive to people's survival are available here, like a very complete small world, which can reproduce on its own.

But as the price to pay for this, the plain that was originally thousands of miles away has completely shrunk by a large part, leaving only an area the size of a small half of the province.

But the aura of this world is extremely strong, although there is a gap compared with that of the main western world, it is not that big.

Other ordinary people can definitely get twice the result with half the effort in this place, but it can't accommodate too many people.

Judging from the data given by the system, this world can only survive at most about 100,000 people to practice. And it is not yet able to live in mortals, it must be some people who have accomplished cultivation, otherwise they will be affected by the filthy atmosphere of mortals.

However, this is also exactly in line with Zhong Yu's wishes. This world was originally a place that he planned to develop and take care of slowly, like a heaven.

He didn't intend to let those mortals without any cultivation to live in. In the future, except for the chief officials of all parties in the heavenly court, only those under his command would be allowed. Those heavenly soldiers and generals could live here, all of them were immortals.
